meta.source: MoSPI / International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS)
meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. Each round is a cross-section; the two rounds are compared by design but are never chained.
meta.coverage: NFHS table 8, maternity care: All India and 36 states and union territories, total, rural and urban, NFHS-4, 2015-16
meta.note: One round of the National Family Health Survey, a cross-section: compare it with the other round side by side, never as a series. Every series is one sub-indicator in one place and sector. Values the fact sheet prints in brackets (an estimate on 25 to 49 unweighted cases) carry flags.caution. Cells suppressed at source ("*", fewer than 25 cases), marked NA or left blank are not baked; meta.omitted counts them. Some NFHS-4 sub-indicators of this table are withheld: MoSPI's API files them against the wrong label or under NFHS-5's wording (meta.quarantined).
meta.flagsNote: caution: the fact sheet prints this estimate in brackets, based on 25 to 49 unweighted cases. inconsistent: the source's total for this place does not lie between its rural and urban figures (flagNote says which).

quarantined.sub: Registered pregnancies for which the mother received a Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card (for last birth in the 5 years before the survey)

quarantined.sub: Mothers who received postnatal care from a doctor/nurse/LHV/ANM/midwife/other health personnel within 2 days of delivery (for last birth in the 5 years before the survey)
quarantined.evidence: API 89.3 belongs to the row above (the MCP card)

quarantined.sub: Average out-of-pocket expenditure per delivery in a public health facility (for last birth in the 5 years before the survey) (Rs.)
quarantined.evidence: API 62.4 is a percentage, not rupees; NFHS-4's mothers' postnatal-care rate

quarantined.sub: Children born at home who were taken to a health facility for a check-up within 24 hours of birth (for last birth in the 5 years before the survey)
quarantined.evidence: API 36.4 belongs to another row; NFHS-5 is 4.2
